topic: An old radio starts playing tomorrow's news.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: Tomorrow's News

shots.narration: The radio announced tomorrow's news—and then it said my name.
shots.scene: Old Pakistani haveli courtyard at night, brass lantern beside an antique radio with blank controls, vertical 9:16, 3D animated film look, no visible text.
shots.action: Bashir points at the radio beside his lantern.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, warm lantern glow, deep courtyard shadows.

shots.narration: Bashir told Saad where he had found it.
shots.scene: Same haveli courtyard, Bashir in his brown shawl and white cap opposite Saad in his dark green hoodie.
shots.action: Bashir gestures toward the distant railway tracks.
shots.mood: Thin ground fog, amber light on attentive faces.

shots.narration: [whispers] Inside an abandoned station, something crackled beneath a dusty cloth.
shots.scene: Flashback inside an abandoned Pakistani railway waiting room, empty benches, covered radio on a wooden desk, no signs or lettering.
shots.action: Bashir lifts the dusty cloth from the radio.
shots.mood: Dust suspended in lantern light, blue moonlight through broken shutters.

shots.narration: There were no batteries, and its wire ended nowhere.
shots.scene: Station desk beside the exposed radio back, empty battery compartment and severed power cable clearly visible.
shots.mood: Faint amber dial glow, heavy black corners.

shots.narration: Tomorrow's news: the chained station gate would open by itself.
shots.scene: Waiting room overlooking a closed iron station gate secured with a thick chain, radio in the foreground.
shots.action: The radio's speaker cloth pulses outward.
shots.mood: Unnatural green dial light, distant gate outlined by moonlight.

shots.narration: [sighs] The following night, Bashir returned to watch that gate.
shots.scene: Same abandoned station the following night, chained gate beyond the waiting room doorway.
shots.action: Bashir settles onto the bench facing the gate.
shots.mood: Dense fog outside, small lantern glow inside, vast empty space.

shots.narration: The chain slipped free; the gate opened without a breeze.
shots.scene: Station entrance, loose chain pooled beneath the iron gate, Bashir visible beyond it.
shots.mood: Perfectly still fog, stark moonlit bars, tense silence.

shots.narration: Then came another headline: Bashir's lantern would go dark.
shots.scene: Waiting room desk, glowing radio beside Bashir's burning brass lantern.
shots.action: Bashir draws the lantern against his chest.
shots.mood: Green radio light against fragile orange flame.

shots.narration: [surprised] This time, it didn't wait until tomorrow.
shots.scene: Close view of Bashir holding his lantern beside the radio in the dark waiting room.
shots.mood: Sudden darkness, only green light beneath Bashir's frightened eyes.

shots.narration: Bashir grabbed the radio, searching for its switch.
shots.scene: Station desk under faint moonlight, extinguished lantern resting beside the radio.
shots.action: Bashir turns the radio toward himself.
shots.mood: Long warped shadows, trembling green illumination.

shots.narration: Behind the speaker cloth, his own tiny face opened its eyes.
shots.scene: Extreme close view of the radio in Bashir's hands, a miniature duplicate of Bashir's face visible behind translucent speaker cloth.
shots.action: The miniature face opens its eyes.
shots.mood: Eyes lit from within, oppressive darkness, uncanny stillness.

shots.narration: [whispers] Now it says Saad will visit the old well tomorrow.
shots.scene: Return to the haveli courtyard, radio between Bashir and Saad beside the burning brass lantern, distant stone well beneath moonlight.
shots.action: Saad turns toward the distant well.
shots.mood: Green radio glow, cold fog surrounding the well, unresolved dread.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow's broadcast sends Saad to a well that answers back.
episode.description: Bashir Chacha tells Saad about an abandoned station radio that broadcast tomorrow's news. Its first prediction came true—but its final announcement was personal. A fictional spooky story from Midnight Watch.
